title: GSPC session event ledger entry
description: One append-only event binding a session/task to observations, checks and decisions. Sentinel-ARCHITECTURE §8: the session-specific event stream between Reported plan, Observed action and Verified outcome. Coverage state is carried on every entry — the panel can never claim more than the stream grants.

host.description: platform adapter id, e.g. chatgpt-app, claude-code-hook, sentinel-browser

coverage.description: mandatory per SENTINEL-ARCHITECTURE §1 — the panel may never claim more than this grants

subject.description: what the event is about (path, tool, axis)

sha256.description: canonical hash of this entry, chained to prev via ledger

ledger_rules.append_only: never edit or delete an entry; corrections are new entries
ledger_rules.human_in_loop: kind=awaiting_human blocks until human_decided references the same session_id
ledger_rules.separation: plan_reported never proves outcome_verified — keep the three labels distinct
